goal: Establish whether the delivered behavior satisfies the stated acceptance checks.
acceptance: At least one meaningful failure case covers the changed boundary.
Passed, failed, skipped and unavailable are counted separately.
A screenshot, typecheck and live integration each support only what they observed.
prompt: Review this revision independently. Verify the user-visible outcome and the highest-risk failure case. Return concrete blockers with reproduction, then stop optional testing once the stated risk is resolved.
